text: Watering initiates the gardening process by maintaining soil moisture so roots can absorb and retain it. Pruning follows as an essential task; this removes branches that are dead, diseased, or harmed in order to stop pests from spreading and to foster healthy development. The practice also limits plant dimensions while stimulating the formation of robust new stems. When these two actions are executed correctly, the garden thrives and offers a suitable environment for bees, butterflies, and other pollinators.
